items.why: In-session control: reproduces kqNgXQqd so every delta is measured against a same-session baseline.

No-trade band AFTER the turnover-controlled weights: cuts rebalancing noise turnover without lagging the signal (unlike ts_mean / lower target_tvr, which the campaign proved destroy Sharpe). Prior hump tests used the default 0.01 band, ~10x a typical TOP1000 name weight, which froze the book (w11_gz_hump: TO 1.6%, Sh 0.14).
Second point of the no-trade-band spectrum (0.03% of book); with the 0.001 slot it maps band width vs turnover retention.

Clean same-unit ensemble of two INDEPENDENT 20-day return forecasts (R20MaRsi chart vs Level-5 GasfCulr chart). Both are predicted returns in the same units, so add() is dimensionally sound. Every earlier cross-model test (b3/b4) was confounded by ts_mean(26)+group_rank(subindustry), the documented signal killer, so this lever was never actually measured.

The external PM prescription (de-bias first, confidence weight, turnover control last). One sign fix vs the PM text: rank(prob) is in [0,1] and all positive, so it must be centered to [-0.5,0.5]; otherwise the book cannot express short conviction. target_tvr held at the seed's 0.12 instead of the prescribed 0.05 so the comparison isolates structure.

PM step 2 (tail purification) with the sign preserved. The PM's literal signed_power(...2) on a confidence-weighted signal is all-positive and would build a long-only book; exponent 3 on a signed centered signal amplifies both tails instead.

Isolates tail emphasis from the PM's rank/group surgery: group_zscore first (preserves forecast amplitude and sign), then signed_power 3, then turnover control and neutralization. Tests whether the campaign's negative signed_power results were an amplitude problem rather than a tail-emphasis idea that fails.

Book-shape + turnover joint optimum: quantile(gaussian) was the best Fitness shape at the seed work point (1.28/0.62), and tvr=0.15 is the Sharpe plateau (1.31). Checks whether the two gains are additive.

The PM's premise is that the product of a positively-offset forecast and a confidence score distorts ordering. winsorize(std=4) is the minimal, amplitude-preserving correction; if the distortion story is right this should help without the shrinkage that killed ts_zscore.
Ensemble at the higher-turnover Sharpe plateau, in case the ensemble needs the extra trading freedom to express its incremental information.
